entities.summary: Félix Auger-Aliassime is a Canadian professional tennis player. He has been ranked by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) as high as world No. 5 in singles, attained in November 2025, and No. 60 in doubles, attained in November 2021. He is the current No. 1 singles player from Canada.
